row.notes: binds an upgrade's name/description/type to VM nodes (Vm_NodeSet_String on obj+0x28/+0x48/+0x68); lng name from a 0x15-entry vocabulary k_Career_UpgradeCardLngTable(0x14571b340) indexed by the upgrade type byte [arg1+4], else lng_invalid; formats %s_description_short. The upgrade_card UI binder (overlaps vm lane). CORRECTION(V9182): It is a card binder, but the lng vocabulary table at 0x14571b340 holds objective names (lng_fast_sector_1.., lng_clean_lap, lng_rnd_obj_*), indexed by a dword at [arg2+0x20] (<0x15), so it binds an objective/R&D card rather than a plain upgrade card; department names come from a separate switch.
